question: What is the name of Russia’s upcoming mission to Venus planned for launch in year 2036?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Venera-D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Russia Plans Venera-D Mission to Venus with Launch by 2036.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Mission name**: **Venera-D**, Russia’s next Venus exploration mission.

 
 
• 
 
**Objective**: To **revisit Venus** with advanced scientific instruments.

 
 
• 
 
**Timeline**: **Preliminary design** starts **January 2026**; launch between **2034–2036**.

 
 
• 
 
**Collaborators**: **Space Research Institute (IKI)** and **Lavochkin Association**.

 
 
• 
 
**Components**: Mission will include a **lander**, **balloon probe**, and **orbital spacecraft**.

 
 
• 
 
**Design phase**: Expected to take **two years**, after which **launch date** will be finalized.

 
 
• 
 
**Programme**: Part of Russia’s **new national space programme**.
